title: high-touch-account-handoff-snapshot-talia
content:
Meeting context:
- Purpose: prep for cross-functional handoff and risk check on ACME Corp (High-touch, $1.2M ARR, renewal in 90d).
- Stakeholders: AE Jasper Li (renewal owner), SE Ravi Menon (post-sales technical), Exec sponsor: Lauren Ortiz.
- Meeting cadence: quick sync before handoff (30 min), then joint renewal plan meeting next week.

Pre-meeting goals (my priorities):
1) Confirm open technical blockers and timelines (from SE) that could impact Q engagement.
2) Align on renewal ask and expansion targets (AE).
3) Surface any ops/usage signals indicating risk and propose mitigations.
4) Capture clear next steps with owners and dates to avoid last-minute scramble.

Data to pull before the call (quick checklist / SQL snippets):
- Last 30/90 day API calls: SELECT date, count(*) FROM usage WHERE customer_id = 'acme-corp' AND date >= current_date - interval '90 days';
- Top error types: query logs -> filter by customer_id + severity >= warn;
- CCU / concurrent sessions trend: export from infra dashboard (hours: 00-06 UTC).
- Billing vs consumption delta: export billing CSV and diff against usage (open issue if > 10% variance).

Key signals I want on the call:
- Product engagement: weekly active users (target > 40 for this seat count), prompt volume trend down >20% is a signal.
- Quality/regression: reported hallucination issues in last 30 days or new eval regressions on anchor prompts.
- Support noise: open tickets > 5 or priority escalations in last 14 days.
- Contract health: outstanding legal terms (data residency/KMS) not resolved -> renewal blocker.

Talking points / script (short):
- Quick sync opener: "Thanks all — goal is a crisp handoff and to flag anything that would change the renewal ask."
- To Jasper (AE): "What is the proposed renewal delta and what exec-level outcomes will get us there? Any open objections?"
- To Ravi (SE): "What work is remaining on the integration checklist? ETA and risks? Anything requiring product or infra help?"
- To myself: "Confirm we're aligned on the mitigation plan and have a draft exec summary for Lauren by Friday."

Risks & mitigation brainstorm (rapid):
- Risk: API latency spikes during month-end causing production alerts.
  - Mitigation: propose short-term reroute to dedicated endpoint during billing window; engineering follow-up + runbook. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 2 weeks.
- Risk: Exec sponsor unclear on ROI metrics.
  - Mitigation: prepare 1-pager with adoption KPIs and dollarized ROI. Owner: Jasper + Talia. ETA: 5 business days.
- Risk: Legal asks for KMS proof-of-concept delaying signature.
  - Mitigation: spin up brief demo environment with KMS logs scrubbing; involve infra eng. Owner: Talia -> escalate to Solutions Eng. ETA: 10 business days.

Draft agenda (30 min):
- 0-3m quick check-in and goals (Talia)
- 3-12m AE: renewal ask & exec risks (Jasper)
- 12-20m SE: integration/tech blockers + plan (Ravi)
- 20-26m Decide mitigation owners & concrete next steps
- 26-30m Confirm follow-ups + calendar invites (Talia)

Post-meeting action item template (capture live):
- Action: [short description]
  Owner: [name]
  Due: [YYYY-MM-DD]
  Success criteria: [how we'll know it's done]
  Linked artifact: [JIRA ticket / Confluence page]

Planned follow-ups (pre-populated items I want to create during/after meeting):
- Create JIRA JIRA-1107 for KMS demo + infra runbook (Owner: Talia). Due: 2025-01-20.
- Draft Renewal Exec Summary (1-pager) with KPIs and ROI; share to Lauren + Jasper (Owner: Talia + Jasper). Due: 2025-01-16.
- SE runbook for latency mitigation; include rollback plan and test matrix (Owner: Ravi). Due: 2025-01-23.
- Schedule cross-functional renewal prep meeting w/ legal & finance (Owner: Jasper). Due: 2025-01-14.

Notes-to-self / negotiation tactics:
- If AE pushes for >15% list increase, ask for time-bound pilot commitment or milestone-based price ramp.
- Keep exec summary focused on 3 metrics: engagement, cost avoidance (ops saved), and strategic go-live wins.
- Use usage delta chart (last 90 days) as neutral data to drive conversation.

Open questions I need answered in the call:
- Is there a hard stop date for the current deployment to avoid migration complexity?
- Any ongoing third-party dependencies (vendor X) that could add risk?
- Are there internal exec changes at ACME that affect renewal sponsor?

Meeting logistics:
- Proposed time: 2025-01-13 09:00 PST (30 min) -> calendar invite ready, include legal rep if AE confirms.
- Join link: (use standard CS call link)

After-call quick checklist (to do within 24h):
- Update this doc with meeting outcomes and mark actionable items.
- Create JIRA tickets for agreed engineering work and link to renewal plan.
- Send meeting recap email summarizing next steps + owners.
- Attach data pulls (usage CSV + latency graphs) to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-8321.

Tone notes (personal):
- Stay neutral when discussing technical gaps. Avoid overpromising.
- Emphasize partnership, not contract pressure.
- Keep timeline conservative for engineering commitments.

Scratchpad (raw):
- Quick numbers from dashboard: WAU ~ 52 last week, token volume -12% m/m, errors (5xx) spike 03-Jan -> need root cause.
- Legal ask: KMS+audit logs + SOC reports requested by ACME security.
- Exec ask: 2-week POC extension possible if outcome metrics are defined.

End of doc.
